individuallyInspected.operation: sips -z 976 822; complete original enlarged exactly twofold, inspected individually.

sourceFacts: One shared image containing two side-by-side subfigures. Left a is a rounded single-crystal specimen viewed obliquely; right b is a stack of sloping straight crystal-layer bands. Both have individual upward and downward tensile arrows.

Subfigure a has a single outlined oblique rounded top face and 12 curved front-side bands. There are 13 front boundary curves including the top-face front rim and the bottom contour. Do not count the rear top outline or the interior top-face hatching as additional layer boundaries.

Subfigure b has 13 sloping bands delimited by 14 straight oblique cross-boundaries. Every cross-boundary slopes down to the right; the left/right outline contains small nonuniform ledges. This is not a six-row atomic array.
Both side outlines show small local offsets between successive boundaries, rather than one uniform whole-specimen displacement. The source gives no numerical offset, length, angle or scale.
The four vertical arrows point away from the specimens: two up above and two down below. The arrows indicate tensile loading, not the direction or simultaneity of atomic slip.

There are zero individually drawn atom dots, zero numerical axes, zero rectangular lattice grids and zero labelled point coordinates. Construction nodes in the modern spec must remain concealed under the source strokes.

The historical subfigure labels are Cyrillic. Current n53 text explicitly uses Latin a/b; use plain Latin a and b only. The source Figure 91 caption remains in the lesson, not duplicated inside the modern crop.

countWitness.method: Manual contour tracing in the individually opened original and enlarged details. Non-OCR vertical ink-run inventories support the trace, but interior texture strokes are excluded by visual topology.
countWitness.aTopFaceNonBoundaryStrokesAtX130: Rear outline around 138 and an interior top-face stroke around 156; neither is an additional front-side band.
countWitness.countTerminology: The two panels are different abstractions, not atom-for-atom corresponding arrays. Do not force their visible side-band counts to match.

approximateSourceScreenAnchors.interpretation: Regularized source-screen contour anchors, not measured scientific coordinates. Preserve exact visible counts, ordering, slope signs and nonuniform ledge relationships, not scan noise.

modernRegularization: Deterministic clean curves and straight band contours replace scan wobble while preserving band counts, oblique face shape, small nonuniform ledges and four outward load arrows.
Old scan texture and side/top-face hatching are omitted; they are not extra atom dots, crystalline planes or displacement vectors.
No new atom array, dislocation core, before/after panel, numeric displacement, loading magnitude or universal slip mechanism is added.

findings.disposition: Settled by tracing: a has 12 front-side bands plus one top face; b has 13 oblique bands. Earlier rough counts mixing the top face with side bands are superseded by this explicit inventory.
Original printing supplies no precise numerical offsets or atom count; contour coordinates are author regularization of visible morphology, not scientific measurements.
